assay_run.method: Study-level comparison aggregate; this row represents the selected preparation groups rather than an individually identified acquisition. C2C12 differentiation RNA-seq contrast with a source-defined reference preparation; the treated arm received 10 ng/ml rADAMTS-1 and differentiated for 3 days, while precise reference handling is not separately reported; Bulk RNA-seq of C2C12 cells treated with 10 ng/ml rADAMTS-1 and differentiated for 3 days; total RNA was isolated, cDNA libraries were prepared, and indexed libraries were paired-end (2×100 bp) sequenced on the Illumina NovaSeq platform by Macrogen. The source reports a Con comparison but does not distinguish individual libraries or physical pooling. Multiple sample IDs preserve group associations and do not establish physical pooling.

sample.sample_material: C2C12 myoblast material treated with 10 ng/ml rADAMTS-1 and differentiated for 3 days for bulk RNA-seq.

Source-defined control/reference C2C12 differentiation preparation in the selected three-day/72-hour RNA-seq comparison. Exact control or vehicle handling and a separately reported numerical rADAMTS-1 control dose are unavailable. Individual replicate, library and physical-pool identities are not established.
